title: Concept: Noscript block breaking out into an event handler
description: A noscript element that closes early and injects an element with a handler in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The parser treats the content of noscript differently once scripting is enabled, so a payload can close the element early and turn the remainder into live markup with a handler.
applicability: Deployments that render a noscript element that closes early and injects an element with a handler into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The parser treats the content of noscript differently once scripting is enabled, so a payload can close the element early and turn the remainder into live markup with a handler.
